chunks.title: International Finance Corporation (IFC) (IFC) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: International Finance Corporation (IFC) is a Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) headquartered in United States (Multilateral). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Founding private-sector partner of Türkiye Industrial Decarbonization Investment Platform (TIDIP) targeting $6B by 2030. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Co-anchoring $6B TIDIP mobilization for steel, aluminum, cement & fertilizer decarbonization plus private-sector climate debt/equity. Source verification: https://www.riotimesonline.com/turkey-eyes-6-billion-green-industry-cop31-antalya/.

chunks.title: IFC Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: International Finance Corporation (IFC) provides the following climate financing instruments: Senior Debt, Equity, Mezzanine, Blended Finance, Green Bond Anchor, Risk-Sharing Guarantee. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 250,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise.

chunks.title: IFC Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by International Finance Corporation (IFC): Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Green Buildings, Climate-Smart Agriculture, Circular Economy. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Emerging Markets, Developing Countries, Türkiye, Africa, Asia, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: IFC Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete IFC's application form: IFC Performance Standards (PS 1-8) compliance; Paris Alignment & GHG emissions accounting; Commercial bankability & audited financials; Private-sector ownership (>50% private or commercially managed). Explicit exclusion rules: New coal-fired power; Unabated fossil fuel projects; IFC Exclusion List activities. Official application portal: https://www.ifc.org/en/what-we-do/sector-expertise/climate-business.

chunks.title: IFC Form Template: Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note
chunks.text: International Finance Corporation (IFC) uses the 'Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note' workflow governed by Joint MDB Paris Alignment Methodology (BB1 Mitigation / BB2 Adaptation) & Environmental/Social Framework. Typical review timeline is 6–16 weeks (Concept Clearance -> Appraisal -> Board Approval). Form sections required: 1. Identification, 2. Strategic Alignment, 3. Financial Structuring, 4. Climate & Technical Rationale, 5. Safeguards & Governance, 6. Execution & Risks, 7. Executive Summary.
